description: This file implements the Telemetry functionality for a plugin, including registration, event handling, and communication with external components via RBus and RFC parameters. It manages privacy settings, report uploads, and power state changes within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: TelemetryImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing telemetry functionalities, including event registration, power management, privacy settings, and report handling.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the telemetry plugin with the service, sets up power management, privacy, and report profiles.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for telemetry events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: SetReportProfileStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the report profile, either STARTED or COMPLETE.

methods.name: LogApplicationEvent
methods.description: Logs an application event with a name and value.

methods.name: UploadReport
methods.description: Triggers an upload of telemetry report via RBus.

methods.name: AbortReport
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing telemetry report upload via RBus.
